={{ JSON.stringify({ prompt: `You are analyzing a VTT transcript file. This could be ANY type of recorded content: meetings, lectures, podcasts, interviews, webinars, conference talks, customer calls, focus groups, depositions, etc.

## Your Task
Read the file \`/transcripts/${$json.filename}\` and create a comprehensive markdown summary.

## First: Identify the Content Type
Before extracting, determine what kind of content this is:
- Meeting (internal team, client, etc.)
- Lecture/Educational session
- Podcast episode
- Interview (job, media, research)
- Conference talk/presentation
- Customer call (sales, support)
- Focus group/User research
- Legal proceeding/Deposition
- Webinar
- Other

This will guide what's most important to extract.

## Create Output Directory
First, ensure /transcripts/summaries/ directory exists (mkdir -p /transcripts/summaries).

## Extract From This File:

### Participants & Roles
- Who is speaking (names, roles, or speaker labels)
- Number of distinct speakers
- Primary speaker vs others

### Questions & Discussion Points
- Questions asked by anyone
- Answers or responses given
- Points of clarification requested
- Unresolved questions or deferred items

### Key Content
- Main topics discussed (in order of appearance)
- Key points, decisions, or conclusions
- Important facts, figures, or data mentioned
- Technical terms or jargon used (with context)

### Actionable Items
- Action items or tasks assigned
- Deadlines or commitments mentioned
- Follow-up items needed
- Tools, resources, or references cited

### Notable Moments
- Key insights or revelations
- Points of agreement or disagreement
- Emotional moments or tone shifts
- Surprising information

### Metadata
- Apparent title/subject
- Estimated duration (from timestamps)
- Date/time if mentioned
- Overall format and tone

## Output Format
Write to \`${$json.outputPath}\`:

# [Title/Subject]

**Source**: ${$json.filename}
**Type**: [Meeting/Lecture/Podcast/Interview/etc.]
**Duration**: ~XX minutes
**Participants**: [List if identifiable]

## Key Questions & Responses

### Q1: [Question/topic]
**Response**: [Summary of answer/discussion]
**From**: [Speaker if known]

[...continue for all significant Q&A...]

## Main Topics Covered

### [Topic 1]
[2-3 sentence summary]
- Key point 1
- Key point 2

[...continue for all topics...]

## Action Items & Follow-ups
- [ ] [Action item] - [Owner if known]
- [ ] [Follow-up needed]

## Tools & Resources Mentioned
- **[Name]**: [Context of how/why mentioned]

## Notable Quotes & Insights
> "[Direct quote if notable]"
- [Key insight or observation]

## Summary
[3-5 sentence overview of the entire recording]

## Content-Specific Notes
[Any observations specific to this content type - e.g., for meetings: decisions made; for interviews: candidate assessment; for podcasts: key guest quotes]

## Instructions
- Be thorough - capture EVERYTHING of value
- Adapt extraction to content type (meetings need action items, lectures need concepts, interviews need key responses)
- Preserve specificity - don't generalize away details
- Note uncertainty - if something is unclear, say so
- After writing the file, output only: "COMPLETE: ${$json.filename}"

Read /transcripts/${$json.filename} and begin.`, maxTurns: 15, workingDir: '/transcripts' }) }}
